description.value:
A creature enters the laboratory without prior authorization from Feskagazar

Effect Alarms blare throughout the complex. The trap rolls initiative.

details.description: The Absolute Zero security system includes a devious array of defenses intended to eliminate or scare away intruders.
details.disable: @Check[computers|dc:20] (trained) to hack into the security system remotely, @Check[thievery|dc:22] (trained) to rewire a security terminal, @Check[deception|dc:20] (trained) to trick the cameras into activating the system in an empty room, or @Check[athletics|dc:22] or @Check[crafting|dc:22] (trained) to throw up a defensive barricade or otherwise block the hazard's path; four successes required to disable security system
details.routine:
(1 action) The security system activates a lethal defense mechanism from the table below; either choose a mechanism or roll a [[/r 1d6]] to determine the effect. All creatures in the area must attempt a basic DC 21 saving throw, with the saving throw type and damage listed. Some defenses have an additional effect listed that occurs on a failed save.
